advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that a ticket directory whose only contents are a folded `*.retired` file (and one with only a `.tmp-event-*` dot file) is treated as event-less and SKIPPED (not `reducer-error`), exercising the `is_active_event`/dot-prefix filters of `_holds_no_events`.
evidence: relation_snapshot.py:197-198 docstring: 'a live event is a non-dot ``*.json`` that is not a folded ``*.retired`` source'

test_event_less... uses `orphan_dir.mkdir()` with `assert not any(orphan_dir.iterdir())` (empty dir) — `any(...)` over an empty iterator is False regardless of the filter predicate, so the discriminating conditions are never evaluated
test_a_populated_but_unreducible... writes a live `COMMENT.json`, exercising only `is_active_event(...) == True`
ABSENCE: no test places a `*.retired` file or a `.tmp-event-*` dot file as the SOLE occupant of an orphan dir to verify it is treated as event-less and skipped rather than failing closed
advisory.finding: The `.retired`-only / dot-file-only branch of `_holds_no_events` — the exact discrimination this diff adds — is untested. The empty-directory test short-circuits `any(...)` without exercising the `is_active_event`, `startswith('.')`, or `is_file()` filters, and the fails-closed test only exercises the live-event (True) branch. No test covers a ticket directory holding only a folded `*.retired` source or a dot-prefixed `.tmp-event-*` file, which the predicate must treat as event-less and SKIP.
scenarios: A regression flipping the `is_active_event`/`.startswith('.')` filter to count a retired or tmp file as a live event would make a retired-only orphan resume raising store-wide reducer-error (the original 043f bug) with no failing test
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a variant of test_event_less_ticket_directory_does_not_fail_an_unrelated_snapshot that seeds the orphan dir with a single `<name>.json.retired` file (and a second variant with a single `.tmp-event-xxxx` file), then asserts the same outcome: the directory is skipped with a path-naming warning and the unrelated snapshot succeeds.
